string-array.name: solo_mode_steps
string-array.item: You will be shown a card with a text prompt.
Aim to guess what could be the answer to this prompt - it could be something such as a definition of the word in the prompt.
When you know the answer, flip your phone towards you. Alternatively, you can press the screen.
On flip, the answer is now visible to you.
Rate the difficulty of the card. Clashcards keeps track of this to help you revise more difficult cards more often.

string-array.name: duo_mode_steps
string-array.item: With 2 players, one is the \'Describer\' and the other the \'Guesser\'.
The Guesser holds the phone up in front of them, with the screen facing the Describer.
The Describer sees the prompt and describes it without saying it. For example, for \"Apple\", say \"a red fruit\".
The Guesser tries to guess the prompt until the timer runs out.
The explanation is revealed when the timer runs out. If the prompt is guessed early, or to skip the question, tap the screen to reveal.
The Describer reviews the explanation, then the Guesser tilts the screen Down for Correct or Up for Wrong.
Repeat until the deck is complete.

string-array.name: multi_setup_steps
string-array.item: One team sets up the game by selecting \'Clash Mode\' from the desired Deck.
Once the lobby is set up, the other team can join the game via the \'Clash\' tab in the navigation bar.
The host team will accept the requests, and set the timer for both teams.
When ready, the teams will split into their roles as per a Duo mode game - one person will be the \'Describer\', and the other \'Guesser\'.
Play out this game and see who can get a better score!

string-array.name: multi_game_steps
string-array.item: In each team of 2, one is the \'Describer\' and the other the \'Guesser\'.
The Guesser holds the phone up in front of them, with the screen facing the Describer.
The Describer sees the prompt and describes it without saying it. For example, for \"Apple\", say \"a red fruit\".
The Guesser tries to guess the prompt until the timer runs out.
If the prompt is guess, or you want to pass the question, tap the screen to reveal the explanation early. When the timer ends, the explanation is revealed automatically.
The Describer reviews the explanation, then the Guesser tilts the screen Down for Correct or Up for Wrong.
Compete to finish the deck first and get a higher score!
